notes.title: Patch update: 1.2.0 - Available for macOS
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are happy to announce that [i]Patch 1.2.0[/i] is now officially live.

In this new version, we have implemented a series of improvements and optimizations to enhance your gaming experience. Here are the detailed highlights of this update:

[list]
[*] [b]Expanded Platform Support:[/b] The game is now officially compatible with macOS! Not only does it support Intel processors, but it also offers full compatibility with the latest M1 and M2 chips.

[*] [b]New Language Addition:[/b] Turkish has been added as a fresh language option for the game.

[*] [b]AI Difficulty Enhancement:[/b] To provide a more challenging and enjoyable gameplay, our AI is now smarter and less predictable.

[*] [b]Real-time Analysis Feature:[/b] A real-time analysis feature has been introduced in the practice mode.

[*] [b]Bug Fixes and UI Optimization:[/b] We have resolved the issue of blurry effects disappearing in the game's UI and optimized the main menu loading time.
[/list]

We sincerely appreciate your support and passion for the game. We will continue to deliver an even better gaming experience to you!

- Studio Amateur

notes.title: Patch update: 1.1.22
notes.content:
Greetings!

It's been a while, and we are back with this [b]new 1.1.22 patch[/b].

[list]
[*] Introducing the Free Play mode! Enjoy the freedom of creating your own shapes. (You can find it in the main menu under "Practice Mode".)
[*] Revamped the interface for Replay and Tsumego modes.
[*] Optimized the frame rates of the main screen and in-game scenes, ensuring a smoother and seamless gameplay.
[*] Addressed the issue that was preventing players from entering the game scene.
[*] Updated and improved some of the translation issues
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722704/ab16516fbdbd458eb3d6f0741e8adf8a7241d4a0.jpg[/img]

As always, If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

Thank you for all the support!

[b]- Studio Amateur[/b]

notes.title: Patch update: 1.0.18
notes.content:
Hi Go players,

Here are the updates for the new version [b]1.0.18[/b]:

[list]
[*] Added "[b]Request counting[/b]" to the game
[*] Adjustable AI resignation mechanism (you can force the AI to delay the resignation until the endgame)

notes.title: Patch update: 1.0.13
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here are the main updates of the new version [b]1.0.13[/b]:

[list]
[*] Analysis mode has been added to Tsumego training, which makes it easier for players to try various solutions
[*] Significantly reduce the loading time between Tsumego questions
[*] Added "9x9 Matches Only" and "13x13 Matches Only" options in career mode
[*] Corrected the wrong Tsumego problems and provided more solutions (will be updated continuously)
[*] Show the most recent 50 games (previously only 20 games were displayed)
[*] Different scenes can be selected when spectating live games on OGS
[*] Fixed the auto-resignation issue when playing 3-handicap games with others on Steam
[*] Fixed the 4k resolution issue
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722704/1827844b7f5e3008a3fe36375aac51bbd8a5353e.jpg[/img]

Based on all the feedback, we will then fix the following issues:

[list]
[*] In Replay mode, add an option to allow the AI to take over and play against you at any point
[*] Provide guidance and tips for beginner-level Tsumego problems
[*] Due to network latency, when playing with friends on steam, both sides sometimes time out at the same time
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722704/3bb7b66a20e7582f7a96e0bf0974fef5b806f11e.jpg[/img]

Thanks again for all the suggestions and feedback! Really appreciated.

[b]- Studio Amateur[/b]

[*] Dead stones will be marked during the territorial analysis

[*] Supported for shortcut keys in replay mode
[*] Reduced in-game CPU usage

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722704/d5004a09a47fbd255fd2ed7eacc8d4941631f1eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722704/c9834255b70a5136dc4e881b9e38bf17df4e50c8.png[/img]

Next week, we'll update the Tsumego answers, remove duplicate questions and show the correct solution (when player can't figure it out).

Thanks again for your support since the release!

notes.title: Just Go is now available on Steam
notes.content:
Greetings!

We're trilled to announce that “Just Go” is now available on Steam, thank you for your continued interest and support!

The game is priced at $9.99 with a [b]10%[/b] launch discount for the first week. If you're interested in the game, then don't miss this opportunity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722704/c7a4b5f4622dc1e80cb493dbfe64f9372176e67f.png[/img]

Compared to the demo version, in the official release, we have added the following:
[list]
[*] A more realistic career mode experience
[*] Over [b]3,000[/b] Go problems (Tsumego) for all levels of players
[*] A fully dubbed Go tutorials for beginners covering from the Opening to the Endgame
[*] Two gorgeous new game scenes (Chinese Garden and Tournament Room)
[*] Upload local games in SGF format (game will provide AI reviews and intelligent analysis)
[*] Global leaderboard to help you find players of similar level and play against them on Steam
[*] Hundreds of classic Go matches have been recorded 
[*] OGS integration improvements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41722704/f81b286ef15b3bd3036f38f7977b81d430902f92.png[/img]

Also, [b]Russian[/b] and [b]German[/b] localization is in progress, and we will add support for both languages later this year.

Finally, we would appreciate it if you could leave a review on Steam about your experience with the game, it would mean a lot to us! Thanks again!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1862520/
- Amateur Studio
